text:
```yaml
name: Build Daytona Snapshot

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: 'Name of the built Daytona snapshot'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate commit SHA
        id: validate_sha
        run: |
          SHA=${{ github.sha }}
          if [[ ${#SHA} -ne 40 ]]; then
            echo "Error: Commit SHA is not 40 characters: ${SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "commit_sha=${SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build Daytona snapshot
        id: build
        env:
          SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF: ${{ steps.validate_sha.outputs.commit_sha }}
          DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME: iterate-sandbox-${{ steps.validate_sha.outputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          echo "Building snapshot with name $DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME"
          npm run build-snapshot
          echo "snapshot_name=$DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
